notes: The predicate of this verbless clause is itself a clause carrying its own finite verbs and no resuming pronoun stands, so the matrix was that is supplied (rule 20); the protasis when is supplied besides (rule 55).
They are marked as two added units on the ground that they do different offices; the alternative single unit for t010-t012 is recorded in the first unit's note.
The waw of וּבָא is unrepresented, and the waw before the flesh hook takes the with the ASV wrote for it (rule 14).
